name: Artículos · Generador Diario (9 AM PT)
description: Generates one draft article every day at 9 AM Pacific Time (17:00 UTC, PST-anchored — drifts to 10 AM during PDT, same convention as the weekly digest). Calls /api/articles/generate on centavos.mx with the x-cron-article header and an empty body; Claude picks both the topic and the author per the rules in the system prompt (no client-side rotation). The endpoint stamps the article with the server's current date, so the draft always reflects "today". The returned object is inserted into the `articles` collection as `status=draft` for the editor to review before publishing.
